children: Attovia Therapeutics, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results, recognizing $0.45M of collaboration revenue and posting a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $(20.69)M, or $(4.88) per diluted share, compared with a $(14.44)M loss, or $(3.71) per diluted share, in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue was $0.45M for 2Q 2026, versus $0.0M in the year-ago quarter; recognition reflects collaboration revenue from EndPath in 2Q 2026.
Net income (loss) attributable to common stockholders was a loss of $(20.69)M for 2Q 2026, versus a loss of $(14.44)M in the year-ago quarter (worse by $(6.25)M YoY).
Diluted earnings per share was $(4.88) for 2Q 2026, versus $(3.71) in the year-ago quarter.
Pipeline advancement: ATTO-1310 completed Phase 1 dosing; ATTO-2306 and ATTO-1091 are in IND-enabling studies targeting trials in H1 2027.
Platform & discovery: The ATTOBODY platform, in-licensed from Alamar, supported nomination of three candidates within two years.
Revenue shift: Began recognizing collaboration revenue from EndPath in 2Q26; the company has no product sales to date.
R&D investment: Research and development spending rose materially year-over-year to support CRO/CMO activities and multiple clinical programs.
Operational runway: Cash plus IPO proceeds are projected to fund operations into 2030, supporting clinical and platform development plans.
